tasks.short: Test choreographic ideas with dancers and hear their feedback

steps.what: Read the actual current rehearsal material and establish which movement or placement idea will be tried
inputs: Actual rehearsal material and creative question
outputs: Actual idea and context for the informal trial

steps.what: Actually try different dancers, steps, dances and placements, observing movement and adapting the next trial with the performers
outputs: Actual embodied trials and observed artistic effects

steps.what: Ask the dancers about the actual trials, hear their informal feedback and explore unclear or conflicting experiences together
outputs: Actual understood feedback and creative possibilities

steps.what: Write and check the actual working movement/placement notation and trial reflections the choreographer uses to continue the work
outputs: Checked actual working trial notation and reflections

steps.what: Save the actual working trial notes in the same notebook

tasks.still_hard: Emergent movement, interpersonal trust and embodied feedback do not become equivalent through generated descriptions.
tasks.human_edge: The choreographer and dancers discover the possibilities together.

ambition.what: Continue genuine artistic experimentation without an unsupported labour-saving claim.
